places.name: Visby City Wall
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage site, the Visby City Wall is a medieval fortification encircling the old town, offering a glimpse into history.

opening_hours.notes: Always accessible. Guided tours available during the day.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking along the wall.

places.name: Gotlands Museum
places.ai_summary: A treasure trove of Gotland’s history, showcasing artifacts, Viking relics, and medieval art.
places.place_tip: Check out the Viking exhibit for a unique experience.

places.name: St. Mary’s Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A stunning example of medieval architecture, St. Mary’s Cathedral is known for its beautiful altarpiece and impressive organ.

opening_hours.notes: Open for services and concerts; hours may vary.

places.place_tip: Attend a concert for a memorable experience.

places.place_tip: Bring a blanket and enjoy a picnic.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to secure a good spot.
